import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data from input directory
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}, Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Sample submission columns to follow exact format
submission_cols = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
col_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}

# Stratified train/validation split using sklearn
X_train_df = train.copy()
y_train_series = train["author"]

test_indices = train["id"].unique()  # Use all IDs for stratification
n_split = int(len(test_indices) * 0.85)

# Create stratified split
train_idx_list = []
val_idx_list = []
for i, class_val in enumerate(np.unique(y_train_series)):
    class_mask = y_train_series == class_val
    n_samples = class_mask.sum()
    split_size = int(n_samples * 0.85)
    idx_class = np.where(class_mask)[0]
    train_idx_list.extend(idx_class[:split_size])
    val_idx_list.extend(idx_class[split_size:])

X_train_np = train["text"].values[train_idx_list].astype(object)
X_val_np = train["text"].values[val_idx_list].astype(object)
y_train_arr = y_train_series.iloc[train_idx_list].values
y_val_arr = y_train_series.iloc[val_idx_list].values

print(
    f"Training samples: {len(train_idx_list)}, Validation samples: {len(val_idx_list)}"
)

# Vectorize text with TF-IDF
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=1)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_np)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_np)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test["text"].values.astype(object))

print(f"Vectorized shapes: {X_train_vec.shape}, {X_val_vec.shape}, {X_test_vec.shape}")

# Train classifier - NOTE: Labels passed directly as numpy arrays, not wrapped
clf = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, solver="lbfgs", warm_start=True)
clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_train_arr)

# Validate on independent held-out set (never refit on full data)
y_val_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)
y_val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val_arr, y_val_pred_proba)
print(f"Validation Multi-Class Log Loss: {y_val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Normalize probabilities row-wise as required by metric formula
row_sums = np.sum(y_val_pred_proba, axis=1, keepdims=True)
# Clip extreme values first, then normalize to avoid extremes in log
y_val_pred_proba_normalized = np.clip(y_val_pred_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
y_val_pred_proba_normalized = y_val_pred_proba_normalized / row_sums

# Verify probabilities sum to 1 within floating point tolerance
assert np.allclose(
    np.sum(y_val_pred_proba_normalized, axis=1), 1.0, atol=1e-7
), "Probabilities did not sum to 1!"

# Predictions for test set
y_test_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)
y_test_pred_proba_normalized = np.clip(y_test_pred_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Normalize row-wise as required
row_sums_test = np.sum(y_test_pred_proba_normalized, axis=1, keepdims=True)
y_test_pred_proba_normalized = y_test_pred_proba_normalized / row_sums_test

# Verify probabilities sum to 1
assert np.allclose(
    np.sum(y_test_pred_proba_normalized, axis=1), 1.0, atol=1e-7
), "Test probabilities did not sum to 1!"

# Create submission dataframe with correct column order
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"],
        "EAP": y_test_pred_proba_normalized[:, 0],
        "HPL": y_test_pred_proba_normalized[:, 1],
        "MWS": y_test_pred_proba_normalized[:, 2],
    }
)

# Ensure output is in correct directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(sub_df)}, columns: {list(sub_df.columns)}")
print(f"Final Validation Log Loss: {y_val_log_loss:.6f}")
print(
    f"Mean predicted prob distribution: {np.mean(y_test_pred_proba_normalized, axis=0)}"
)
